q: .............. is an advanced storage array that uses sophisticated software, cache management, and virtualization techniques.
explain: **Intelligent Storage System (ISS)**.

q: The Intelligent Storage System provides ..................
explain: الـ ISS بيقدّم **high performance, scalability, availability, automated data management**.

q: Why was the intelligent storage system needed?
choices: HDDs even with RAID could not meet the performance requirements of today's applications
explain: **HDDs even with a RAID implementation could not meet performance requirement of today's applications**.

q: The four key components of an ISS are:
choices: Front end, cache, back end, and physical disks
explain: **Front end · Cache · Back end · Physical disks**.

q: ................ connects the storage system to the host servers.
explain: الـ **Front end** بيوصّل الـ storage بالـ hosts.

q: ............ execute appropriate transport protocols: SCSI, Fibre Channel, iSCSI.
explain: **Front-End Ports**: اتصالات وبروتوكولات نقل، و redundancy.

q: On writes, the front-end controller sends an acknowledgment to the host:
choices: Only after the data is on tape
Before committing the data to disk (for speed)
explain: **Controller sends acknowledgment to host before committing to disk (for speed)**.

q: .............. determines the execution order of received commands and can reduce unnecessary drive head movements.
explain: **Front-End Command Queuing**.

q: When a command is received, the command queuing algorithm assigns a ______ that defines the execution sequence.
explain: **assigns a tag that defines a sequence in which commands should be executed**.

q: ................ executes commands in the received order.
explain: **FIFO**: الافتراضي، ومش كفء.

q: ................ reorders commands to minimize head movement.
explain: **Seek Time Optimization**: مثلًا A → C → B → D.

q: ................ considers both seek time and rotational latency and provides the best performance.
explain: **Access Time Optimization** = seek + rotational latency ← **الأحسن**.

q: .......... is semiconductor memory where data is placed temporarily to reduce the time required to service I/O requests.
explain: **Cache** بيقلل التأخير الميكانيكي (seek + rotational latency).

q: Accessing data from cache typically takes:
explain: **Cache < 1 ms** · **Disk = few milliseconds**.

q: Cache is divided into:
explain: **Data Store** (البيانات) + **Tag RAM** (metadata).

q: .........indicates if cache data has been written (committed) to disk.
explain: **Dirty bit flag**.

q: ............helps identify unused data to free up cache.
explain: **Last access time**.

q: The smallest unit of cache allocation is the:
explain: **Cache is organized into pages (slots) → smallest unit of allocation**.

q: In ............., data is found in cache (via tag RAM) and sent directly to the host.
explain: **Read Hit**: ~1 ms ومفيش disk operation.

q: In .............., data is not in cache and the back-end controller fetches it from disk.
explain: **Read Miss**: من الديسك ← الـ cache ← الـ host، فأبطأ.

q: In ............, data is written to cache and immediately to disk, then acknowledgment is sent.
explain: **Write-Through**: آمن بس أبطأ.

q: In ........., data is written to cache, acknowledgment is sent to host, and later written (de-staged) to disk.
explain: **Write-Back**: سريع جدًا بس فيه خطر فقد بيانات.

q: The main risk of write-back cache is:
choices: Data loss if the cache fails before data is written to disk
explain: **Risk of data loss if cache fails before data is written**، ومحتاج battery-backed cache أو mirroring.

q: In write-around (cache bypass), data bypasses the cache when:
choices: The write I/O size exceeds the write-aside threshold
explain: **Write-around**: لو الكتابة أكبر من الـ **write-aside size** تروح للديسك على طول، فمتملاش الـ cache.

q: Why is write-around used?
choices: To prevent large sequential writes from consuming too much cache space
explain: بيحافظ على الـ cache للـ I/Os **الصغيرة والعشوائية**.

q: In ..........., memory is partitioned into one set for reads and another for writes.
explain: **Dedicated Cache**: نسب ثابتة (مثلًا 40% read و 60% write).

q: In .........., a single pool of memory is shared by both reads and writes.
explain: **Global Cache**: أكفأ وأكثر مرونة.

q: In a global cache with dynamic allocation:
choices: The user fixes the ratio forever
The system automatically adjusts the read/write ratio based on workload
explain: **Dynamic allocation**: النظام بيعدّل لوحده (write أكتر وقت الـ backup، و read أكتر وقت الـ analytics).

q: In ..............., pages that haven't been accessed for the longest time are freed.
explain: **LRU**: الأشهر.

q: In ................, pages that were accessed most recently are freed.
explain: **MRU**: مفيد في الـ sequential reads.

q: In LRU, if a page to be reused contains dirty data:
choices: It is flushed to disk before reuse
It is mirrored to the host
explain: **If the page has dirty data, it's flushed before reuse**.

q: Moving data from temporary fast storage (cache) to permanent slower storage (disk) is called:
explain: **Flushing**.

q: Which flushing type occurs when the cache is almost full and writes data aggressively?
explain: **High Watermark Flushing**: الـ cache قرب يتملي، فبيكتب بشكل مكثف عشان يمنع overflow.

q: Which flushing type is triggered by a critical event (like shutdown or power failure) and flushes immediately?
explain: **Forced Flushing**: فوري بغض النظر عن مستوى الـ cache.

q: Idle (low watermark) flushing:
choices: Writes aggressively when cache is full
Writes data gradually and smoothly when cache is moderately used
explain: **Idle/Ideal Flushing**: تدريجي وهادي، عشان يحافظ على الأداء.

q: In ................, writes are duplicated to two memory cards for redundancy.
explain: **Cache Mirroring**: بيحمي من عطل هاردوير الـ cache.

q: In .............., cache contents are safely dumped to vault drives during power loss.
explain: **Cache Vaulting**.

q: The limitation of a battery backup unit (BBU) alone is that:
choices: It keeps cache alive only temporarily with limited capacity
explain: **BBU: keeps cache alive temporarily, but capacity is limited**، فبيتجمع مع vaulting.

q: ........... provides an interface between cache and the physical disks.
explain: **Back end** = back-end ports + back-end controllers.

q: Back-end controllers handle:
choices: Read/write with disks, RAID, and error detection/correction
explain: **Back-end controllers**: communicate with disks، و RAID، و error detection/correction.

q: For high availability, storage systems are configured with:
choices: Dual controllers with multiple ports providing alternate paths
explain: **Dual controllers with multiple ports** + ديسكات **dual-ported**، وكمان load balancing.

q: ................... is a logical volume created from physical drives or RAID-protected drive groups, presented to the host as if it were a physical disk.
explain: **LUN (Logical Unit Number)**.

q: A host needs 200 GB from a 1 TB disk. Using a LUN, the remaining capacity available for other hosts is:
explain: 1000 − 200 = **800 GB**، وده فايدة الـ LUN في استغلال الديسك.

q: A meta-LUN is:
choices: A larger logical unit created by aggregating multiple LUNs
explain: **Meta-LUN**: تجميع LUNs، ويوسّع السعة من غير ما يوقف الـ host.

q: ............. allocates the entire requested storage capacity upfront.
explain: **Thick**: بسيط ومتوقع، بس **underutilization**.

q: ............. allocates storage on a just-in-time basis.
explain: **Thin**: استغلال أحسن، بس خطر **over-provisioning**.

q: A host requests 500 GB but uses only 100 GB. With thin provisioning, the physical storage consumed is:
explain: في الـ **Thin** المستهلك = المستخدم فعلًا = **100 GB**.

q: In ..............., I/Os are performed to a LUN through all available paths.
explain: **High-end = Active-Active** (كل المسارات).

q: In ..............., I/Os are performed to a LUN only through active paths.
explain: **Midrange = Active-Passive**.

q: Which array type is generally aimed at large enterprise applications and connects to mainframes and open systems?
explain: **High-end**: large enterprise، و fault tolerant، و mainframe & open systems، وسعة و cache كبار.
